summary: E014 send-site keyboard attachment is correctly flag-gated, scoped, and ordered. Flag defined once with clear inverted-default comment near DEDUP_SERIES_ENABLED. Flag-off path is byte-identical to pre-feature behavior. Token mint + put_review_token happen before send and are contained within the existing E014 try/except so a storage/build fault degrades to a logged failed-ping, never breaking E015/E016 paths or publishing. No other alert site touched. All 3 new tests pass; full suite (1310 tests, known flaky TestSlotLoopTransientRetry excluded) is green.

findings.description: Verified signatures against definitions: admin_alerts.build_dedup_review_keyboard(token) (admin_alerts.py L754), pending_articles_repo.put_review_token(token, link) (L1049), send_admin_notification(message, *, max_attempts=..., reply_markup=None) (news_bot.py L485-506). All calls match; reply_markup=None default makes the flag-off call identical to pre-feature invocation.

Confirmed the diff touches only the `if decision == 'flag': ... if alerted:` branch. The `block` (E015) branch at L2441-2464 and the outer except handler (E016, L2527-2559) are untouched and never receive reply_markup — verified no other send_admin_notification call in this region got a keyword change.

kb=None default plus token mint/put_review_token/build_dedup_review_keyboard all execute inside the same try that wraps send_admin_notification. A failure in put_review_token or the keyboard builder is caught by `except Exception as notify_err` and logged as "Failed to send E014 notification", exactly matching the 'dedup never blocks publishing' contract carried by the surrounding outer try/except (L2433-2559). mark_pair_pinged + dedup_conn.commit() at L2520-2523 execute regardless, so rate-limiting bookkeeping is unaffected by a keyboard-path fault.
findings.recommendation: None — matches Decision 12 / task hint explicitly calling this out.

findings.description: 3 tests cover: flag-on (keyboard shape + button order cancel-first + token persisted to bot_state before send), flag-off (no reply_markup, no bot_state row, asserts REVIEW_BUTTONS_ENABLED not in os.environ to guard the default), and mixed E014+E015 run (only E014 call carries reply_markup, confirms E015 fired in the same run so the assertion isn't vacuous). Helpers reused from TestCrossSourceDedup via plain-function assignment (not subclassing) to avoid re-running its 20 methods — noted and correct.
